executions.name: operation-8-1
executions.execute-prompt:
You are running a scheduled ISO 9001:2015 control 8.1 (Operational planning and control) check for {{repository-name}} on {{git-ref}}.

This is a cron run: there is no webhook payload, no issue, and no work item. Do not wait for labels.

Resolve evidence sources from OPERATION_SOURCES_FILE (default .xianix/operation-sources.yaml in the clone). Fetch every enabled source using the Operation plugin providers. Do not guess extra systems. Missing optional provider tokens mark that source UNAVAILABLE and the run continues.

Run /operation 8.1 --sources .xianix/operation-sources.yaml

Write iso-9001-8.1-operational-planning-and-control.md at the repository root. Do not open a pull request and do not push unless this prompt is later extended to publish the report.
